newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA PANK GAINS BIG IN EARLY TRADE.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA PANK GAINS BIG IN EARLY TRADE.

text.p: * Total turnover 32.9 million kroons of shares
* Tallinna Pank dominates early trade and gains seven kroons.
Tallinna Pank dominated Monday's morning trade on the Estonian bourse as investor confidence retuned to the market, dealers said.
The official list registered a volume of 31.3 million kroons of shares by 12O0 local time.
"Tallinna Pank is expected to regain some lost ground with the news that it has removed the shipping loan from its books," said one dealer.
Tallinna Pank shot up in morning trade, registering turnover of 12.5 million kroons with a bid/ask of 67.10/67.75 kroons against Fridays's close of 60.65 kroons.
"Other stocks are expected to be active as investors set themselves up for different share holders' meeting during the week," one trader said.
Forekspank was weakened with a spread of 153.55/153.850 kroons compared to Friday's 154.40 kroons on a trade of 5.6 million kroons of shares.
Hoiupank recorded a turnover of 5.1 million kroons of shares to gain with a bid/ask of 110.80/111.95 compared to Friday's fix of 106.25 kroons.

Union Bank advanced at 45.25/45.60 kroons against a fix of 44.90 kroons with shares worth 4.5 million kroons traded. Hansapank shares were up on a spread of 218.00/219.50 kroons against 216.08 on a trade of 3.4 million kroons of shares.

The free market turned over 1.5 million kroons of shares with Rakvere meat plant the most traded. Rakvere was stable with a registered trade valued at 0.7 million kroons with a bid/ask spread of 13.10/13.35 against 13.25 kroons.
